summary: Magazine layout: banner, a category chip strip, one featured article with three latest items beside it, then one row per category of three cards. Needs six to seven categories and about 20 articles.

sections.note: purple banner with H1 and strapline left and two flat circles right
pale pink strip of seven uppercase category links, centered, wrapping to a second line
left two thirds: large photo, big title and excerpt; right a list of three titles with dates divided by rules
per category a row: outline pill with the category name and a View all link, then three cards (photo, title, date); repeated for six categories
